title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.35767v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. translated_title: 基于交错强化学习的统一模型原生反思学习
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型既能观察图像也能渲染图像，因此原则上它们可以修复自己的生成结果：诊断图像存在的问题、进行修改、观察结果，然后再次诊断。由于一次修改是否有帮助只有在渲染之后才能得知，因此反思文本与图像生成必须在整个循环中联合学习。基于反思轨迹的监督微调（SFT）可以提供冷启动，但无法找到高成功率的修复路径；而仅优化渲染器或仅优化单个头的朴素强化学习则会留下大部分尚未开发的收益。我们提出UMM-Reflection，它在单个统一模型内对完整的反思轨迹应用强化学习（RL）：同级轨迹共享同一初始图像，因此组相对优势可以比较不同的反思策略；同时，一个轨迹级别的优势同时更新反思token与基于流的图像修改，从而避免组合……
tldr: 提出UMM-Reflection方法，在统一多模态模型内对完整反思轨迹应用强化学习，联合优化反思文本与图像生成，使模型能够自我诊断并迭代修复自身的生成结果。
en_tdlr: UMM-Reflection applies reinforcement learning to complete reflection trajectories within a unified multimodal model, jointly optimizing reflection text and image generation so that the model can self-diagnose and iteratively repair its own generations.
